changes.summary: Resolve the registered PLE table's CUDA device address once per allocation and use it in both gathers; unregister memory if address resolution fails.
Use CACHE_BASE/tilelang for compiled kernels across native and container launchers, preserving explicit TILELANG_CACHE_DIR overrides.
Refresh the NVMe reader's source guard for the reviewed QSA and PLE source, retaining all required hook checks.
Print the Penny Royal release, source commit and local-modification marker at startup.

validation.review: Accepted after independent review and correction
validation.tilelang: Published image reproduces UID1001/HOME=/ failure; staged entrypoint passes actual TileLang import and mounted-cache persistence across two disposable containers.
validation.nvme: All 11 guard hashes match the assembled source; installed container reader registers and applies all six required hooks with staged source and guard.
validation.cuda_symbol: Resolved cudaHostGetDevicePointer through the actual container PyTorch dependency handle, CUDA 13.0; no GPU used.
validation.wsl2: Contributor hardware reproduction and testing; local regression tests use distinct mocked host/device addresses.
validation.reused_runtime_qualification: 3.0 qualification and performance in release-3.0.json and RESULTS.md; no changes to model defaults, sampling or adaptive policy.
